description: This file defines an interface class IPluginStarter that declares a method to activate a plugin within the Thunder framework. It includes documentation comments explaining how the activation method should behave, particularly regarding retries and delays.

classes.name: IPluginStarter
classes.description: An interface for starting (activating) plugins within the Thunder environment, with a method to activate a plugin with retry logic.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Activates a Thunder plugin, retrying up to maxRetries times with a specified delay between attempts. Returns true if activation succeeds within the retry limit, false otherwise.
